title: Bipedal3Vec over Vec<u64> pair with mask_tail invariant
description:
Implement `Bipedal3Vec` (variable-length packed $\mathbb{F}_3$ vector backed by a pair of `Vec<u64>`) with the project's `mask_tail` invariant strictly enforced on every mutation.

## Background

`Bipedal3Vec` is the variable-length companion to `Bipedal3`. It stores a packed $\mathbb{F}_3$ vector of length `len_lanes` as two `Vec<u64>` (mag and sgn) of length `ceil(len_lanes / 64)`, with padding bits beyond `len_lanes` in the last word kept zero on both vectors. This matches the project's foundational invariant from `gf2-core::bitvec` (CLAUDE.md §Key design invariants).

Per D1b, `fold_mul` is inherent on `Bipedal3Vec` (encoding-specific reduction tree), not a trait method. This issue defines `fold_mul` as the first inherent method.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::packed::bipedal3::Bipedal3Vec` exists with backing `Vec<u64>` pair and `len_lanes: usize`.
- [ ] [hard] Every mutating operation calls `mask_tail()`; padding bits beyond `len_lanes` are always zero on both `mag` and `sgn`.
- [ ] [hard] Element-wise `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` implement `PackedFieldVec<Fp<3>>` and cross-check against per-lane `Bipedal3` ops via proptest.
- [ ] [hard] Inherent `fold_mul` reduces all lanes to a single `Fp<3>` via the bipedal multiplication tree.
- [ ] [hard] Word-boundary tests cover `len_lanes` $\in$ {0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129}.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes.
